fix: reject negative n in generateNKeysBetween (#43)

A negative n slips past the n === 0 / n === 1 checks: with one bound
null the for loop simply does not run and the call silently returns a
single key; with both bounds set, Math.floor(n / 2) goes negative and
the function recurses until the stack overflows. Enforce the documented
'n >= 0' precondition with a clear error instead.
